name: Manara Elegant Posture Tension
description: Milo Manara style. Long-limbed idealized female proportions, small nose, feline eyes. Clean confident contour line with soft classical chiaroscuro. Sculptural rendering of skin and form. Graceful mid-gesture posture, weight shift, spinal twist. Figures that feel ready to move or have just moved. Elegant unapologetic sensuality without vulgarity.
